tokens.name: frame
tokens.usage: Board or browser canvas visible around the page frame. Never carries text.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: The page itself, and the ground of the note card. Text on it: ink, ink-muted.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Image card mat and the nav pill ground. Text on it: ink, ink-muted.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: 1px borders on image cards and the avatar ring. Decorative separation only, so no 3:1 requirement; never the only cue for state.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All primary text (names, nav labels, note copy) on surface, surface-raised and frame.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Captions and secondary labels on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: grid-pink
tokens.usage: Grid-paper lines on the note card, and the pink block on the cover. Decorative; never used for text.

tokens.name: photo-sky
tokens.usage: Sky blue sampled by eye from the hero photograph. Placeholder fill for image slots and a cover block; never text.

tokens.name: photo-green
tokens.usage: Green sampled by eye from the hero photograph. Placeholder fill for image slots and a cover block; never text.

tokens.name: window-close
tokens.usage: Close dot in the browser-window chrome. Decorative.

tokens.name: window-minimize
tokens.usage: Minimize dot in the browser-window chrome. Decorative.

tokens.name: window-maximize
tokens.usage: Maximize dot in the browser-window chrome. Decorative.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Added, not in the Figma source: solid 2px focus outline, at least 3:1 on surface, surface-raised and frame in both themes.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Intro note copy and any running text.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Project label under an image card; window title.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between window-chrome dots.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between avatar and name; caption offset under an image.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card padding and grid-paper pitch.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Nav pill horizontal padding and gap between nav labels.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Page gutter and gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Vertical distance between the header, the content and the nav pill.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Image cards, the note card and image slots.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Browser window.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Nav pill and the round NJ avatar.

shadow.note: Soft, low-contrast shadows; the nav pill and avatar read as gently raised.

tokens.name: shadow-soft
tokens.usage: Nav pill and avatar.

tokens.name: shadow-note
tokens.usage: Note card lifted off the page.

tokens.name: shadow-window
tokens.usage: Browser window pop-up over the Work grid.
